title.narrative: Search for Common Ground MENA programme

description.narrative:
Objective of contribution:
To strengthen women's and youth's meaningful, enduring participation in advancing inclusive peace and security in the Levant and Yemen
Programmet syftar till att främja kvinnors och ungdomars meningsfulla och varaktiga deltagande och bidrag till fred och säkerhet i Levanten och Jemen
The programme aims to strengthen women's and youth’s meaningful, enduring participation in advancing inclusive peace and security in the Levant and Yemen

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative:
During the period, results have been achieved in the following outcome areas:
Outcome 1.1: Mentorship and strategy building that foster the collective impact of women's rights organisations and youth led organisations and reconciliation efforts have been strengthened in the Levant and Yemen. Outcome 1.2: Influential and diverse networks among women's rights organisations and youth led organisations have been expanded and reinforced in the Levant and Yemen. Outcome 2.1: Institutions and key decisionmakers relevant to Women Peace and Security and Youth Peace and Security have increased understanding of tools to conduct intersectional, gender and age sensitive policymaking. Outcome 2.2:Institutions and key decisionmakers relevant to Women Peace and Security and Youth Peace and Security have increased ability to mainstream gender and youth inclusion in peace and reconciliation processes. Outcome 3.1: Young women and men in the Levant and Yemen are empowered to actively promote and amplify inclusive narratives around peace and security. Outcome 3.2: Perceptions of target community groups in the Levant and Yemen are shifted towards increased support for women and youths meaningful enduring inclusion in peace and reconciliation processes.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
